verdict.rationale: A live probe found a valid llms.txt at docs.retellai.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Retell AI docs summary), and the docs pages are served as raw .md files, which is the agent-oriented format this story asks for. The evidence shows these surfaces exist but says little about their depth. Missing for 10: llms.txt content beyond the header, any llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
